cultural.vision_reason: This is a carved wooden lid with classic Benin (Edo) court iconography — the Oba with mudfish legs holding an eben sword, a leopard, warriors, and interlace border patterns — a well-known Edo courtly art motif, though the object itself is wood, not ceramic.

physical.title: lid
physical.summary: Lid; carved from solid wood. Rectangular in form decorated on all external surfaces. Top surface decorated  with central figure of Oba with mudfish legs holding eben sword and ?staff; leopard below. Warrior at right angle to Oba carries spear and has quiver with arrows. Human figure flanking Oba on left has snakes issuing from top of head. Two smaller flanking figures hold swords. One figure holds container on top of head. Sides of lid have different forms of interlace pattern; scorched in places on long sides. Interior of lid has white pignment on base; some scorching around edges.
